Title: (LSJ) Spirit's Touch, continued action and another block

Messages.Author: JH
Messages.Body:
Minion A is acting, minion B plays Spirit's Touch at AUS to block it.
In the resulting combat minion B maneuvers to long with Spirit's Touch
and minion A strikes with Form of Mist at PRO to continue the action.
If Minion B succeeds in blocking that action again (after waking and
playing more intercept), can he use the maneuver from the Spirit's
Touch also in the second combat?

Spirit's Touch
Cardtype: Reaction
Discipline: Auspex
[aus] +1 intercept.
[AUS] As above, with an optional maneuver in the resulting combat if
this vampire successfully blocks this action.
